permissions.description: Open the access administration area.
Assign roles to users and grant permissions to them directly, with a scope.
See a user's roles, direct grants, virtual roles and effective permissions.
Create roles and change their names, permissions and active state.
See the roles, their permissions and the permission catalog.
Assign queue records to other users who hold the record type's queue permission.
Work record queues: list a queue, claim a record and release your own (with the record type's queue permission).
Remove a record's attachments (where the record allows it).
Upload files and link them to a record (where the record allows it).
List attachment types and a record's attachments, and download them (where the record allows it).
Read the audit trail of every audited table (personal data masked).
Open the dashboard.
Run a background job now.
List the background jobs and their run history.
Activate and deactivate lookup values.
List the lookup types and every value of a type, active or not.
Send oneself a test notification to check the bell, e-mail and SMS delivery.
Create, edit, deactivate and reactivate organizations.
List and open organizations.
Replace the sections of the FAQ, service guide, privacy and terms pages.
Read the FAQ, service guide, privacy and terms content in the admin editor.
Read every record of every record type, read-only (admin oversight).
File service requests: create, fill in and submit a draft, resubmit and cancel your own request.
Approve, reject or return a service request under review.
See the service request work queue and the requests in it.
Start the review of a submitted service request.
See your own service requests.
Change the value of a runtime setting.
List the runtime settings with their values and defaults.
Preview and commit an Excel user import.
Create, edit, deactivate, reactivate and unlock user accounts, and issue activation links.
List and open user accounts.
